logo.label: Logo
logo.doc: The mark in the bar. An SVG stays crisp at any size.

logo_height.label: Logo height
logo_height.doc: How tall it is in the bar, in pixels. The bar sizes itself from its contents, so a taller logo makes a taller bar — and it still scales down when the page scrolls.

brand_name.label: Brand name (read aloud by screen readers)
brand_name.doc: What someone using a screen reader hears in place of the logo image.

logo_href.label: Logo links to
logo_href.doc: Where clicking the logo goes. Worth checking if a temporary landing page is ever sitting at the root.

layout.label: Layout
layout.doc: Where the logo sits and how the links arrange around it.

link_size.label: Link text size
link_size.doc: The size of the words in the bar, in pixels.

link_gap.label: Space between links
link_gap.doc: The gap from one link to the next. Tighten this before reducing the size when a long menu is close to wrapping.

left.label: Links before the logo
left.doc: Only used by the layouts that put links either side of a centered logo.

right.label: Links after the logo
right.doc: As above, for the other side. On a logo-left layout this is the only one that counts.

more_label.label: “More” button text
more_label.doc: The wording on the button that opens the overflow panel.

bar_max.label: Links on the bar before “More”
bar_max.doc: 0 means show every link and never overflow. Any other number caps the bar and moves the rest into the panel.

pin_pages.label: Pages
pin_pages.doc: Whether the page links sit in the top group, which scrolls if it is long, or the bottom group pinned to the foot of the screen.

pin_social.label: Social
pin_social.doc: Same choice for the social icons.

pin_wordmark.label: Wordmark
pin_wordmark.doc: Same choice for the wordmark at the foot of the menu.

order_pages.label: Pages
order_pages.doc: Where this block sits within its group.

order_social.label: Social
order_social.doc: Where this block sits within its group.

order_wordmark.label: Wordmark
order_wordmark.doc: Where this block sits within its group.

tm_link_size.label: Page link size
tm_link_size.doc: The big menu words, in pixels.

tm_gap.label: Space between blocks
tm_gap.doc: The gap between the pages, the social row and the wordmark.

tm_wordmark_size.label: Wordmark size
tm_wordmark_size.doc: How wide the wordmark is at the foot of the menu.

tm_label_size.label: Small label size
tm_label_size.doc: The size of the “Menu” and “Follow” labels.

show_pages.label: Pages
show_pages.doc: The page links. Hiding these leaves a menu with only the social row and wordmark.

show_social.label: Social
show_social.doc: The social icons. They come from the menu assigned to BRG — Social under Appearance → Menus; hiding them here leaves that menu alone.

show_wordmark.label: Wordmark
show_wordmark.doc: The wordmark at the foot of the menu.

show_menu_label.label: “Menu” label
show_menu_label.doc: The small label above the page links.

show_social_label.label: “Follow” label
show_social_label.doc: The small label above the social icons.

show_numbers.label: Numbers (01, 02…)
show_numbers.doc: The running numbers beside each page link.

menu_label.label: “Menu” label text
menu_label.doc: The wording of the small label above the page links.

social_label.label: “Follow” label text
social_label.doc: The wording of the small label above the social icons.

wordmark.label: Wordmark
wordmark.doc: The mark at the foot of the phone menu. Leave empty and the menu ends with the social row.

wordmark_line.label: Line under the wordmark
wordmark_line.doc: A short line beneath it, like a strapline. Leave empty for none.
